recipes.name: Cinnamon Vanilla Nut Butter
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*. Spread the cashews on one baking tray, and the pecans on another. Toast for 7 minutes. Remove the pecan tray from the oven and set it aside to cool.
Stir the cashews and return them to the oven to toast for an extra 5 minutes, or until lightly golden. Careful not to burn. When toasted, remove from the oven.
In a food processor (ideally 600W or higher), combine the toasted nuts, cinnamon, vanilla, and salt. Blend on high for 5 to 7 minutes until smooth**.
Transfer to a jar for storage. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** If your food processor isn't very powerful, blend for up to an extra 5 minutes or consider adding a bit of vegetable or coconut oil.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 months.
